Veterans Benefits: Texas has no state income tax, so military retirement pay is untaxed at the state level. Disabled veterans receive a rating-scaled residence-homestead exemption, and a 100% service-connected or individually unemployable veteran receives a total homestead property-tax exemption, with surviving-spouse continuation.

Description: Abilene is an affordable West Texas city built around Dyess Air Force Base (B-1B bombers and C-130J airlift). It offers an in-city VA outpatient clinic, Texas's no-income-tax treatment of military retirement pay, low housing costs, and Walmart access, with three universities giving it a college-town feel. Tradeoffs include a moderate crime rate, hot semi-arid summers, and no local Costco.
